# CLI reference

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs:sync` from system/lib/cli-usage.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Run every command from the Toolkit folder. Commands that change a project take it explicitly; none of them keeps a global active project.

| Command | Synopsis | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `projects` | `npm run toolkit -- projects [workspace-root]` | List valid projects under projects/ with issues (errors) and warnings. Read-only. |
| `init` | `npm run toolkit -- init <new-folder> <namespace>` | Create an empty project with its own permanent namespace. Never overwrites. |
| `next` | `npm run toolkit -- next --project <projects/folder>` | Recommend the one next step for the project (fix, prepare UI-kit data, generate, build, check, import, done). Read-only. |
| `doctor` | `npm run toolkit -- doctor --project <projects/folder>` | Diagnose the project; every issue has a code, path and next action. Read-only. |
| `ui-kit` | `npm run toolkit -- ui-kit <project-folder> [--data <kit.json>] [--font <primary font>] [--replace] [--check]` | Generate source/ui-kit/ from design-system/kit.json in the canonical scaffold. --check validates the data without writing; --replace regenerates unchanged generated files. |
| `artifact add` | `npm run toolkit -- artifact add --project <projects/folder> --key <ui-kit|components/name|pages/name> --html <file.html> --css <file.css> [--css <more.css>] [--external-css <file.css>] [--root <.class>] [--intake <intake.json>] [--depends <key>] [--title <text>]` | Register a component or page (stylesheets are one cascade in order). --external-css (repeatable) names a stylesheet of the target site: it comes first in the cascade, its classes are used by name and never packaged. |
| `artifact list` | `npm run toolkit -- artifact list --project <projects/folder>` | List registered artifacts with status and current HTML/JSON paths. Read-only. |
| `build` | `npm run toolkit -- build --project <projects/folder> --artifact <key>` | Normalize, compile, check shared classes and publish one HTML preview + JSON package pair; prints links for preview and comparison. |
| `catalog` | `npm run toolkit -- catalog --project <projects/folder>` | Regenerate output/html/index.html from the results catalogue. |
| `check` | `npm run toolkit -- check --project <projects/folder> --artifact <key> --level <local|editor|published> --result <passed|failed> --note <what was checked>` | Record one verification level for the current build. |
| `serve` | `npm run toolkit -- serve [--port <number>]` | Serve the Toolkit folder read-only on 127.0.0.1 (default port 4320) for previews and the comparison tool. |

## Single-page and support commands

| Command | Synopsis | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `intake` | `npm run toolkit -- intake <project-folder> <intake-relative-path>` | Validate a source intake declaration. Read-only. |
| `normalize` | `npm run toolkit -- normalize <project-folder> <html-relative-path> <css-relative-path> [--root <.class>]` | Legacy single-page normalization into source/normalized/. |
| `compile` | `npm run toolkit -- compile <project-folder> <manifest-relative-path> <new-output-file>` | Legacy compile of a normalized manifest into a new JSON file. |
| `migrate-v1` | `npm run toolkit -- migrate-v1 <legacy-json> <asset-root> <new-output-file>` | Convert a version-1 package with an asset folder into one version-2 JSON. |
